cards.title: Tonight, in order
cards.body:
1. Gmail server - five mailboxes live
2. Tuition figure corrected - 48 families, $5,516.06
3. StreamBomb replica trap - fixed and in production
4. GitHub connector - root cause found after two sessions
5. vJoy - confirmed driver bug, no fix exists
6. The real find: six shutdowns were sleep-transition failures

cards.title: Waiting on you
cards.body:
Amber home -> test her Gmail line
Bounce my voice line -> typed input goes live

cards.title: Watching
cards.body:
Fast Startup off. Baseline was one crash every ten days.
A clean month means it worked.
